chronology.message:
fix: Handle schema drift in merged_gw.csv when API adds new columns (#221)

Fixes #203 - FALSE instead of 0 in saves column

The issue occurred because:
1. FPL API added 7 new mng_* columns mid-season (GW22)
2. merge_gw() appended new data without updating the header
3. This caused column misalignment (data shifted by 7 positions)

Changes:
- Rewrote merge_gw() to detect and handle schema changes
- Added regenerate_merged_gw() to rebuild merged file from scratch
- Updated main() with proper CLI interface and backwards compatibility
- Regenerated data/2024-25/gws/merged_gw.csv with correct schema

New columns properly handled:
- mng_clean_sheets, mng_draw, mng_goals_scored
- mng_loss, mng_underdog_draw, mng_underdog_win, mng_win

Usage:
  python collector.py regenerate data/2024-25/gws
  python collector.py merge 38 data/2024-25/gws

Co-authored-by: Mr-Neutr0n <neutr0n.git@gmail.com>
Add missing gw22 data (xP.csv not available)
